title: Restore deep authorized Command Incident from Investigate across Work Queue pagination
goal: Complete CAP-CMD-106 Class-0 Incident → Investigate → Incident return when the original Incident is not on the first 50 rows, using the existing owner-filtered Command Work Queue and its revision-bound cursor, never a new permission or separate Incident engine.
invariants: Return hint is untrusted browser navigation only; Command Owner.List and Owner.CanRead for every in-scope object are re-executed on each GET before looking for its ID.

Existing Work Queue selections remain page-bound and JSON selection contract remains unchanged. Only exact HTML GET view=incidents&selected=Incident:<id>&restore=1 with no other key or explicit cursor may perform source-authorized page lookup.
Restore finds the ID only among the FULL authorized/filtered/sorted bounded <=5000-row Command cohort, not raw owner IDs; if missing/revoked/foreign -> generic 404 with no data.
Restored third page has a freshly computed revision-bound cursor for normal next/previous HTML pagination; client cannot supply offset, pagination digest or permission.
No Incident/Case update, new auth engine, source IO, hidden information, class-2 operation, external URL, credential or production IAM.
Source PR #207 HEAD 5a3aa252e369d31f34d96989bd3e72c8e1c16dd6 and all upstream reviewed SHA remain immutable.
security_properties: Fail closed on forged/duplicate/unknown restore, wrong view, Task selection, JSON Accept, explicit cursor, filters or unsafe ID before host session.
A formerly authorized Incident revoked by Command Owner cannot reappear because restore never trusts Case origin alone.
Incident selection must remain owner-authorized and same tenant/environment; cross product hint never grants Investigate Case rights.

migration.rationale: Only read-only authorized page focus and optional HTML-only presentation query; no persisted data.

rollback.strategy: Remove return focus hint and narrow Work Queue focus logic; legacy Case return resumes first-page-only behavior with no persisted change.
verification: Legacy JSON queue selection remains strict
Normal native page three selection with explicit current cursor unaffected

inputs: Existing CAP-CMD-106 Command Incident and CAP-INV-110 authorized Class-0 navigation and source return on #207
Current Work Queue can paginate fully authorized 123+ rows, but selected Incident from Case return fails 404 if off the first 50.
outputs: Original selected Incident returns correctly even if on page three; source-authorized same-origin Work Queue renders correct page, HTML selection, prev/next cursors.
Off-page selection without restore stays denied, API JSON unchanged, invalid restore fails before owner, revocation gives 404 with no leak.
acceptance_tests: Normal no-restore selection of off-page Incident remains 404 (prior explicit cursor invariant).
HTML read-only restore deep Incident #100 succeeds only if the current Command Owner authorizes it after all 124 in-scope ACL decisions; returns its correct real page and cursor.
Revoking target access before return fails generic 404 and no stale content.
Restore in JSON or with Task, extra query keys, cursor or malformed token rejects 400 before owner lookup.
Original Case/source roundtrip points to single canonical relative Command route using restore=1 and still independently authorizes Incident.
Full Work Queue/Timeline/Command-investigate-host Go/race/vet and global engineering checks pass on exact head SHA.
definition_of_ready: Parent #207 E10-CMD-106H-RETURN IMPLEMENTED, exact SHA CI 4/4 green, in draft pending independent review. No modification to parent L2 head.
Canonical CAP-CMD-106 Incident Detail return §17/§25 and screen CMD-IWQ-006 allow safe deep links; OPEN-013 mutations excluded.
definition_of_done: End-to-end browser-style local synthetic Incident→Case→Source→Incident works for an off-page Incident without changing permission boundaries.
Exact head CI and no mandatory waiver; independent L2 on significant cross-product navigation when ready.
No merge nor CAP-wide acceptance unless upstream reviewed approvals/CI and ownership are separately met.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse existing bounded O(N<=5000) source authorization and sorted page digest; one additional O(N) in-memory target lookup and cursor encoding, no new network/source query or production SLO.
metrics: at most 5000 authorized items per read
no additional provider calls beyond existing Project owner List/CanRead
